name: Cellach

attributes.attribute: caused the end of his father's reign

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cellach is an Irish hero. He was the son of the good king Cormac Mac Airt. His acts against a woman drew the wrath of her vengeful father. Cormac fought that man and lost an eye. A blemished king could not reign. Cormac had to step down from the throne of Tara. Cellach played little part in myth except to end his father's reign.

okr.objective: Cellach is the Irish warrior whose deeds ended his father Cormac Mac Airt's reign.
key_results: He is the son of the king Cormac Mac Airt.
His deeds against a woman provoked her father's revenge.
Cormac lost an eye and became a blemished king.
